description: This Java source file defines an annotation processor named OperatorProcessor, which processes classes annotated with org.tensorflow.op.annotation.Operator to generate a convenience API class called Ops. It scans for @Operator annotations, collects associated factory methods, and generates API classes that provide simplified access to TensorFlow operations within the TensorFlow Java client library.

classes.name: OperatorProcessor
classes.description: An annotation processor that detects @Operator annotations in classes to generate an aggregated Ops API class for TensorFlow Java. Implements processing logic, collection and validation of annotated classes, and code generation of API classes with methods for creating TensorFlow operations.
